owner_text: DECISION 3 -- PILLAR B: DEFER the thirteen rule moves that still lack ablation evidence. Disposition: DEFERRED_BY_OWNER_QUOTA (2026-10-04)
reopen_trigger: after the next weekly quota reset, ONE Owner yes for E1 at or under spend_cap; never started by a timer, a mission or a session on its own

experiments.question: For each still-resident global rule: does moving it out of the per-call prefix (a skill stub) lose any verified task outcome, and how many prefix bytes does it remove?
experiments.champion: arm A: the current prefix, rule resident (P3 method)
experiments.challenger: arm B: the same prefix with --settings claudeMdExcludes naming the rule file(s)
experiments.design: per set of up to 3 rule files: 6 judgement tasks x 2 arms x 2 replicates = 24 runs, arm order alternating, one model; tasks exercise each rule's judgement and are frozen in an ADDENDUM committed before any counted run (as ADDENDUM-R2.md)
experiments.quality_floor: arm B task_pass >= arm A on the same tasks, every run valid; ANY judgement-check loss in arm B keeps that rule resident

spend_cap.basis: P3 R2 set, measured: 24 runs = 16,670,492 context tokens, 61,886 output tokens, 1,834 s wall (results-j-r2.jsonl, all 24 valid)
spend_cap.request: at most 5 sets = 120 runs, about 83 M context and 0.31 M output tokens
spend_cap.unit: logical transcript tokens; the weekly account meter's weighting is UNKNOWN and is not derived from these numbers

stop_conditions: spend_cap reached: stop, report the sets completed
a run invalid (precondition or harness failure): rerun once; a second invalid run stops the set
a ceiling (every run passes in both arms) is recorded as 'no loss observed', never 'no effect'
invalidation: a candidate rule's sha256_lf differs from this packet (re-measure bytes, refreeze tasks)
the model id or the claude CLI major version differs from the ADDENDUM
a task file edited after its ADDENDUM commit
experiments.success: per rule MOVE (no loss observed, bytes removed) or KEEP_RESIDENT (a loss observed); each MOVE still needs its own Owner yes before ~/.claude/rules is edited
experiments.failure: the set is inconclusive (invalid runs, cap reached): no rule moves on it
experiments.expected_evidence: results-<set>.jsonl, ADDENDUM-<set>.md, a REPORT.md section per set

provenance.model: claude-opus-5-5 (as P3; restate in the ADDENDUM)

not_in_this_packet.program_champion_challenger: Only [L] is active and it acts on the background compound pipeline, whose effect is read from ~/.claude/state/compound-unattended.log at no extra spend (ledger state.L.activation). No mechanism with a per-call effect is ACTIVE, so a program-wide live A/B has nothing to compare yet; it becomes a packet entry when one is.
